title: Immunohistochemistry Protocol for IBA1 Staining
author: Jennifer Rutkowsky
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.56pg9dn

steps.title: Prepare Tissue Sections
steps.instruction: Prepare four-micron thick, formalin-fixed, paraffin-embedded tissue sections on charged slides.

steps.title: Deparaffinize and Treat Sections
steps.instruction: Remove paraffin and treat sections with hydrogen peroxide.

substeps.instruction: Deparaffinize through xylene to 100% reagent alcohol
Treat with 0.3% hydrogen peroxide in 100% methanol for 30 minutes

steps.title: Rehydrate and Perform Antigen Retrieval
steps.instruction: Rehydrate sections and perform heat-induced epitope retrieval (HIER) for IBA-1.

substeps.instruction: Rehydrate to deionized water through 95% and 70% reagent alcohols
Perform HIER in a Black & Decker Steamer using Target Retrieval Solution for 30 minutes at 95ºC
Allow to cool down for 20 minutes

steps.title: Rinse and Buffer Sections
steps.instruction: Rinse slides and transition them to buffer.

substeps.instruction: Place slides in 0.1M Phosphate Buffered Saline (PBS), pH 7.4

steps.title: Block and Incubate Primary Antibody
steps.instruction: Block sections and apply primary antibodies in a humidity chamber at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Block for 20 minutes with antibody diluent
Apply primary antibodies without rinsing and incubate for 1 hour
Rinse twice for three minutes with PBS-Tween 20

steps.title: Apply HRP Label
steps.instruction: Label rabbit anti-IBA-1 using a polymer-based HRP.

substeps.instruction: Apply single step, polymer based HRP (BioCare Medical, RC542H) for 30 minutes

steps.title: Visualize and Counterstain
steps.instruction: Visualize labels and finish the sections.

substeps.instruction: Visualize labels with NovaRed for peroxidase (Vector SK-4800) per manufacturer's instructions
